To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the application of stochastic diffusion processes for the description of the motion of molecules in chemical reactors is not straightforward.
the stochastic diffusion model of the isothermal one-dimensional chemical reactor is capable of predicting the conversion of the reactants and the applicability of the Danckwerts boundary conditions.

a stochastic model of the continuous flow chemical reactor is a more general approach that enables the application of the conventional simplified models to be assessed from the more general point of the view of the applicability of the Danckwerts boundary conditions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of a stochastic description of the motion of reacting molecules for the derivation of a model of a continuous flow chemical reactor.
the development of a mathematical description of a one-dimensional chemical reaction system.
the application of stochastic diffusion processes for the description of chemical engineering phenomena.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the stochastic diffusion model is a valuable tool for the description of chemical reactor phenomena.

the model presented is not only a useful tool for the description of the chemical reactor but also an excellent illustration of the applicability of the stochastic diffusion processes for the description of chemical engineering phenomena.
the stochastic model is a very powerful and useful tool for the analysis and description of chemical reactors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the application of stochastic models for the description of the chemical engineering phenomena is not always possible.
the stochastic model of an isothermally operating chemical reactor is more general than the conventional model and enables a more complete description of the reacting system.
the stochastic model of the isothermal chemical reactor is a generalization of the conventional model and that the conventional model is an approximation to the stochastic model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a stochastic approach to the description of the chemical engineering phenomena can be used to derive more realistic models of chemical reactors.

the application of the stochastic description of diffusion processes for the description of the chemical engineering phenomena is possible only in the case of the diffusion processes with the diffusion coefficient equal to zero.

the stochastic description of chemical reaction processes is not only an alternative approach to the classical deterministic description but also a useful tool for the analysis of the reaction processes.
